newsitem.title: USA: Overland Data named in shareholder suit.
newsitem.headline: Overland Data named in shareholder suit.

text.p: The law firm of Abbey, Gardy & Squitieri LLP said on Tuesday that it has filed a shareholder lawsuit seeking class action status against Overland Data Inc, accusing the company of making misleading statements.
The lawsuit was filed on behalf of purchasers of the stock between February 21, 1997, when it had its initial public offering, through March 14, 1997, the law firm said.
Overland Data has not seen the lawsuit and the company does not have a comment about it, Vern LoForti, chief financial officer of the company, said.

The complaint charges that the company and its officers and directors violated securities laws by making misleading statements that the company has resolved digital linear tape drive component shortages that affect the company's main product, the law firm said.
